text:
docs-scan: periodic snippet-sanity run found a runtime-config example in docs/runtime/config.md that references DEPRECATED_ENV="1" and an old `--fast-start` flag. sample: `docker run -e DEPRECATED_ENV=1 redwood/runtime --fast-start` -> causes startup failures on newer images. full report: https://internal-reports.company/snippets/3180001111.csv

kevin: who is the owner for docs/runtime? i don't see a CODEOWNERS entry for that folder. pinging folks who recently touched it.

mara: i touched config.md in march but i'm not an owner. i can take a quick look — is this breaking prod or mostly examples?

raj: examples only, but the deprecated env leaks into one of our internal quickstarts used by new hires. noticed a few interns hit it in onboarding last week. repro: `./scripts/onboard --use-docs-snippet` pulls the example verbatim.

kevin: ok can we do a docs-first change: update snippet to `REDWOOD_MODE=legacy` and remove `--fast-start`; add a short callout that older releases use the old flag. if infra changes needed, ops can add compatibility, but prefer doc update. tagging `docs/sprint` and `onboarding`.

mara: i'll claim this. quick ask: csv link 403 for me — can someone paste the exact lines with filenames?

raj: pasted samples here: `docs/runtime/config.md:45: docker run -e DEPRECATED_ENV=1 redwood/runtime --fast-start`, `docs/onboarding/quickstart.md:12: docker run -e DEPRECATED_ENV=1 redwood/runtime --fast-start`

ci-bot: note: there's an open lint rule request to detect `DEPRECATED_ENV` usages in markdown. see branch `lint/doc-snippet-deprecations`.

mara: plan: (1) open small PR to update the two snippets and add an inline note about compatibility; (2) add a docs-lint rule that fails CI if `DEPRECATED_ENV` or `--fast-start` appears in markdown links/snippets; (3) add a short entry in the onboarding checklist to use `scripts/onboard` which normalizes snippet consumption.

kevin: 👍. when you open the PR, include a staging QA step for the onboarding flow: run `./scripts/onboard --preview` and confirm the rendered quickstart uses the new env. also add a changelog line in `docs/CHANGELOG.md` to help internal search.

mara: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4120 — updates snippets, adds lint rule (separate commits) and a changelog note. assigned @kevin for review. added QA checklist in PR description.

raj: left a minor comment asking to keep the human-friendly example (not just the env var) and to include a one-liner migration note for infra folks who rely on `DEPRECATED_ENV` (ops ticket if rollback needed).

kevin: i'll review today. thanks for the quick pickup. once merged, i'll run onboarding smoke locally and mark the scan alert resolved. :white_check_mark:
